Skip navigation Skip to main content Read Our Blog Get OurE-Newsletter Visitors Guide SavingsPass Follow Us! #VisitWilm Moonloop Photography Share Email X Facebook LinkedIn Reddit Historic New Castle, Delaware Vibe: Colonial Chic Explore the history of the First State at the New Castle Court House Museum, where Delaware voted to break away from Pennsylvania in 1776. Exhibits chronicle the trials of abolitionists Thomas Garrett… Moonloop Photography Try the colonial-inspired English, Swedish and American dishes at Jessop's Tavern or sample a taste of New Orleans at Nora Lee's French Quarter Bistro. Moonloop Photography The Jack A. Markell (JAM) Trail connects Wilmington's Riverfront with Historic New Castle — rent a bike in Wilmington, stop for lunch in New Castle and be back by dinner time. Moonloop Photography Separation Day, commemorating the day Delaware stopped being Pennsylvania, is celebrated in mid-June.
